name: MMLU
summary: Four-choice questions in 57 subjects, including elementary mathematics, US history, computer science and law, testing the world knowledge and problem solving of text models.

splits.v: dev (5 questions per subject), validation (1,540), test (14,079)

protocol.v: four-choice multiple choice, zero-shot or with up to 5 dev examples; the answer is the letter of highest probability

versions.name: MMLU (test set)

data.location: data.tar linked from the README of github.com/hendrycks/test; cais/mmlu on Hugging Face

protocol.scorer: accuracy over all questions of all 57 subjects (Section 4.1); a mean of the 57 subject accuracies is the metric macro-accuracy, not this one

human_baseline.note: the authors' estimate of expert-level accuracy (Section 3); unspecialized Amazon Mechanical Turk workers 0.345

versions.known_issues: the released files hold 14,042 test and 1,531 validation questions (cais/mmlu, config all), not the 14,079 and 1,540 of Section 3
